workflowRules: MANDATORY IMMEDIATE SELLER DEEP DIVE: whenever any seller is added to any watchlist status (permanent, watch, provisional, negotiation target, seller of interest, or equivalent), immediately in that same run search that seller's active LEGO inventory across all current purchase-priority categories. Do not defer the sweep, suggest that the user browse the store, or merely state that a future deep dive should occur.
A seller may be added to a watchlist because of a user-supplied listing or an assistant-discovered listing; the same immediate deep-dive requirement applies in both cases.

Deep dives must cover at minimum printed/decorated tiles, minifigure components/accessories, windows/doors/glazing, transparent/translucent parts, scene/interior/detail parts, incomplete identified sets, and seller-specific combined-shipping/quantity opportunities when relevant.
DISCOVERY IS NOT VALIDATION: search-result pages, stale/indexed pages, caches, category pages and snippets may identify a candidate/item ID but can never establish that a listing is live.

LIVE CANONICAL VERIFICATION: a live deal notification requires a current direct canonical item fetch that shows the exact item ID and present availability. Canonical URL existence alone is insufficient. If the direct fetch fails, is stale, shows ended/out-of-stock, redirects to an ended page, or cannot prove current availability, mark the record needs_revalidation/failed and do not notify.
CANADA SHIPPING HARD FILTER: only surface seller-deep-dive candidates that verifiably ship to Canada. Mark M6H shipping unresolved if destination-resolved checkout shipping cannot be obtained.

COMBINED SHIPPING IS UNTRUSTED UNTIL CHECKOUT: never infer a rational single-parcel rate merely because eBay or a seller says 'Save on combined shipping'. Test the actual M6H cart. If shipping scales irrationally, move to seller messaging for a manual invoice or custom/bundled listing.

RANDOM DIVERSITY HAS POSITIVE VALUE: do not penalize a genuine random assortment merely because it contains pieces outside the explicit purchase-priority list. Favor high variety, low duplication and imagination/inspiration value when the underlying price is reasonable.
Preserve purchased, expired, inactive and historical records in the appropriate operational/historical/calibration files.
Use M6H 2W9 destination-resolved shipping when available; never substitute a U.S. proxy as Toronto shipping.
